---
title: "Method Selection and Modern Frontiers"
---

## Core Question

Given a biological question, what mathematical object should we build?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Compare strings, graphs, hidden-state sequences, trees, matrices, tests, and ODEs.
- Build a method-selection guide.
- Practice with project-style prompts.
- Require one assumption and one failure mode for each method choice.
- Audit project validation checks.
- Long-read assembly as graph plus error model.
- Pangenome graphs as graph generalization.
- Profile HMMs as richer sequence-family models.
- Deep sequence models as learned scores or representations.
